title: Python and Qt Tool Development for 3ds Max
description: Develop Python and Qt tools for 3ds Max from verified starter templates: MaxScript launcher, safe restart, frameless window with rounded corners and a collapsed bar that follows Max, themed shared controls, Settings / Logs / About / Donate, interface size for 2K and 4K screens, crash-safe start, layered testing and official MaxPkg MZP delivery.
author: Lukianenko Vasyl / 3DGROUND
